subject: Request to include VP sponsor — need to realign demo timing
messages:
From: Abigail Cho <abigail@luminahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo next week — quick ask

Hi Hannah,

Quick one — Marcus (our VP of Engineering) asked to be looped into the demo you have scheduled for our team on Jul 16 at 11:00 PT. He's currently traveling but indicated he could make time on Jul 15 in the afternoon (window: 2:30–4:00 PT). He believes seeing the integration and routing fallbacks will determine our procurement timing, so his presence would be helpful.

If you can move the session to Jul 15 at 3:00 PT that would be ideal for us. If a move isn't possible, could we either:
- keep Jul 16 and record for him, or
- keep the call but shift the start 30 minutes earlier so he can dial in between flights?

We're under a tight procurement cadence and want to avoid another round of scheduling. Let me know what works on your side.

Thanks,
Abigail
Director of Product
Lumina Health
[attachment: none]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Abigail Cho <abigail@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@luminahealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo next week — quick ask

Hi Abigail — thanks for the flag and totally understood about the procurement timeline. 

Two options that work on our side:
1) Move the demo to Thu Jul 15 at 3:00 PM PT (we'll reserve 60 minutes, proposed agenda attached).
2) Keep Fri Jul 16 at 11:00 AM PT and make it 75 minutes with an explicit CTO/VP segment at the top (we can record and provide a short executive summary).

I'm attaching an updated agenda (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf) and a calendar update (calendar-update.ics). If you prefer option 1, reply with a quick ✅ and we'll send an updated invite.

Jonas (SE) and Laura (AM) — can you confirm internal availability for Jul 15, 3:00 PM PT? Jonas, we may need a slightly different demo flow to prioritize the architecture + fallback discussion for Marcus.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we can be flexible to avoid delaying the deal.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
[attachment: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, calendar-update.ics]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo next week — quick ask

Hannah / Laura — quick internal note.

I can cover Jul 15 at 3:00 PM PT. If we shift, I'll reorder the deck to open with architecture (15 mins), then live routing/fallbacks (25 mins), and finish with cost/ops Q&A (20 mins). That should hit Marcus' ask.

Heads up: I'll be remote after 5 PM PT that day and won't be available for a later-run rehearsal; if we want to do a 30-min dry run, it needs to be before EOD Jul 14.

Also attached the latest MSA redlines we expect — if procurement wants to push signature after demo we should confirm points now so contracting can run in parallel.

-Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer

Subject: Confirmed: Demo moved to Jul 15, 3:00 PM PT — updated invite

Hi Abigail / Marcus — thank you for the quick responses.

We confirmed internally and have moved the demo to:
Thu Jul 15, 2026 — 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM PT (calendar invite attached).

What we'll cover (brief):
- 0–15m: Executive architecture overview (why routing/fallbacks matter)
- 15–40m: Live demo: prefix caching, model routing, fallback policies
- 40–60m: Ops & procurement touchpoints + next steps

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, calendar-update.ics.
Links: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765), DocuSign preview (https://www.docusign.net/envelope/XYZ-1234).

Looking forward to it.

Best regards,
